title: Sheds
lead: A calm, worldwide platform for antler shed hunting — species knowledge, personal finds, seasonal forecasts, and ethics without trophy culture.
mission: Help shed hunters observe sign, understand cervid ecology, record private finds, and plan ethical outings across all antler-shedding species.
principles: No leaderboards, find rankings, or trophy competition
Exact find coordinates stay private by default
Support White-tailed Deer, Mule Deer, Elk, Moose, Caribou, Red Deer, Fallow, Roe, Sika, and other cervids
Encourage empty-handed miles as valuable field evidence

modules.title: Species browser
modules.description: Cervid species profiles: shed timing, habitat, and regional notes.

modules.title: Personal finds ledger
modules.description: Private WOS-aligned find records with media, notes, and privacy controls.

modules.title: Heat map architecture
modules.description: Aggregated, obfuscated seasonal intensity — never public pin-drops of finds.

modules.title: Forecast architecture
modules.description: Weather, snow, and phenology signals for shed likelihood by region.

modules.title: Regulations framework
modules.description: Jurisdiction-aware guidance with clear provenance labels.

modules.title: Trail camera integration
modules.description: Import architecture for camera evidence linked to private observations.

modules.title: AI prediction framework
modules.description: Future model hooks — clearly labeled, never presented as certainty.

dataModel: Local Sheds models (FindRecord, SpeciesProfile, ForecastPackage) extend the shared Waypoint Observation Standard via namespaced extensions. Privacy levels: private, shared, public, anonymized.
